Personality
Generate Ability Scores✔
Method 1: Point Buy
Standard: 27 points, scores 8–15 (5e-style costs).
Method 2: Roll Ability Scores
4d8, discard the lowest two dice, six times; assign the results to abilities as you see fit (type them into the helix on Core). If you don’t have at least two scores above 13, or any score is below 6, you may reroll.
Method 3: Transhuman Point Buy
Only use this method if you want to pick the Transhuman genome. It uses a purchase table — シ400,000, scores 10–18.
Choose Your Genome✔
Your genome modifies your base ability scores and grants additional traits.
Choose Your Background✔
A background grants two proficiencies (skills, weapon or armor), a vocational proficiency, equipment, and a feature.
Choose Your Class✔
Choose Equipment✔
Your starting equipment is based on your genome, class and background. Your background’s equipment and cash were granted when you chose it, and a wealthy genome pays out on its own — this button covers what your CLASS grants: either a lump of cash, or a handgun, a pack, reinforced clothing and a smaller sum.
Starting at Higher Levels applies only if your character was created above 1st level — it is the money for gear they acquired before play began, and it is separate from the class package above.
Max HP✔Character creation complete
Autocalculate determines your max hp for you, or you can enter it manually instead.
Results
A running record of everything Create Character has done, newest first. A Reminders panel appears above the Log only when something needs YOUR action — choices to make or manual steps.
Reminders
Log
Sheet type
Fix character level
Stat Tuning
Manual Point Buy
The flat form of Create Character’s point buy pop-ups. Standard: 27 points, scores 8–15 (5e-style costs). Transhuman: the genome’s purchase table — シ400,000, scores 10–18. Set the six scores, then select Apply to write them to the Core sheet double-helix.
Method
Genome Tools
Applying a genome fills the Genome traits list on the Core tab and ADDS its ability score increases to your scores — roll or buy your scores first, in Generate Ability Scores on the Create Character tab. Fixed numbers (Leviathan +4 Strength, +2 Constitution) apply themselves; only genomes with a real choice ask you to pick, in Reminders. Re-applying or switching genomes never stacks — the previous genome’s increases are removed first. Roll Enhancement / Roll Flaw are for the Mutt genome, and their score changes apply as you roll them. The single-enhancement and flaw pickers below are for traits gained individually (Genetic Tweak upgrades, Transhuman purchases, the genetic enhancement hack); everything lands in the Core tab Genome list.
Background Tools
A background grants two proficiencies (skills, weapon or armor groups), a vocational proficiency, equipment, and a feature. Apply writes the name to the Core identity bar, grants fixed skills, and adds the feature (with vocational and equipment details) to Class & Background Features; choice-based proficiencies land in Reminders. If a granted skill duplicates one from class or genome, the book lets you pick a different skill from your class list instead. Making your own background: see Chapter 1.
Class Tools
Pick your class (plus up to two more for multiclassing), then press Apply. Results — class text, proficiency, pooled hit dice, granted skill proficiencies, and class features up to your level — are written to the Core tab. Archetypes unlock at level 3.
First Class
Second Class
Third Class
Single-Feature Picker
Single-feature picker: adds ONE class feature (with its free hacks and modifiers) to the Core tab. Normally unnecessary — Apply above adds everything for your level automatically. Use it for GM grants, rebuilding a deleted row, or reading a feature before you commit.
Feats
Pick a feat and press Add — it is written to the Feats list on the Core tab. Feats are typically taken in place of an Ability Score Improvement. Some feats wire themselves up: a fixed ability score increase (Silver Tongue, Polyglot, Emotive Communicator) is added to your score, a choice of scores (Weapon Enthusiast, Striker, Rugged Bodied…) becomes a Reminder naming the options, armor/weapon training ticks on, and per-use riders (Melee Monster, Kill Shot, Finesse Fencer, Unflappable Talents) arrive as Global Modifier rows — open a row's cog to set its details, e.g. tick Unflappable's two chosen skills.
Max HP Autocalculation
Autocalc uses the rounded-up average — d8=5, d10=6, d12=7, with 1st level at 13/16/19 — plus Con mod per level and known modifiers (Tough as Nails, Unbreakable, Wings, Synth Organs). That is a slightly HIGHER result than rolling on average, and it keeps the heart-block Max on the Core tab current automatically. Leave it off to roll for HP and manage Max by hand.
